# Chapter 5B High-Recall Routing — CIDOB Biography (BOOK-013)

## Routing Parameters
- **Chapter:** 5B (Economic Wellbeing)
- **Questions:** 5B.1–5B.10 (all 10 lenses active)
- **Mode:** High recall — threshold for inclusion is any marginal economic-policy relevance, not confirmed substance
- **Ruler:** Andrés Manuel López Obrador (Mexico, 2018–2024 presidency)
- **Source:** CIDOB political biography (open, machine-readable)

---

## Included Chunks

### U0001 — INCLUDE
**Relevance:** Marginal. Establishes biographical anchor: presidency 2018–2024, party (MORENA), successor (Claudia Sheinbaum). Confirms the ruler-period under evaluation.
**5B lenses:** None directly applicable; period-defining.
**Adjacent context:** U0002 begins the political-rise narrative; U0001 is purely institutional framing.
**Cited lenses:** —

---

### U0002 — INCLUDE
**Relevance:** Marginal. Early political characterization: "discurso combativo," "banderas sociales," "escarnece a los poderes fácticos." Contains first ideological positioning on economic-popular themes. Notes videoescándalo corruption-adjacent episode under DF administration.
**5B lenses:** 5B.1 (sustainable prosperity vs short-term popularity rhetoric), 5B.5 (corruption exposure in his administration), 5B.7 (response to corruption — political counterattack framing).
**Adjacent context:** U0003 continues 2006 election narrative; U0002 ends with 2005 desafuero buildup.
**Cited lenses:** 5B.1, 5B.5, 5B.7

---

### U0003 — INCLUDE
**Relevance:** Low–marginal. 2006 election contestation, "fraude" claims, self-proclaimed "presidente legítimo." Economic policy content minimal; flags anti-neoliberal rhetoric in opposition.
**5B lenses:** 5B.7 (denial/scapegoating framing of electoral defeat), 5B.1 (anti-neoliberal platform as short-term popularity vs structural reform question).
**Adjacent context:** U0002 covers carismática leadership; U0004 continues opposition to Peña Nieto.
**Cited lenses:** 5B.1, 5B.7

---

### U0004 — INCLUDE
**Relevance:** Marginal. Opposition to Peña Nieto's structural reforms (energy, telecom, labor, fiscal). Critiques of economic governance, claims of corruption and incompetence. Policy substance for evaluating 5B.3 (macroeconomic rules), 5B.4 (competition/regulatory fairness), 5B.5 (anti-corruption enforcement record).
**5B lenses:** 5B.1 (anti-neoliberal rhetoric vs rents/platform), 5B.3 (critique of EPN fiscal/macroeconomic rules), 5B.4 (opposition to energy/telecom reform regulatory changes), 5B.5 (corruption accusations against EPN), 5B.7 (scapegoating Trump narrative).
**Adjacent context:** U0003 covers 2006–2012 arc; U0005 introduces 2018 campaign economic platform.
**Cited lenses:** 5B.1, 5B.3, 5B.4, 5B.5, 5B.7

---

### U0005 — INCLUDE
**Relevance:** High. Direct articulation of 2018 campaign economic program. Explicit policy content: "austeridad republicana," social investment reorientation, fuel price policy, energy/food self-sufficiency, anti-corruption promises, migration policy. Substance for 5B.1–5B.10 across all lenses.
**5B lenses:** 5B.1 (austerity as structural vs patronage), 5B.2 (institutional independence claims), 5B.3 (macroeconomic discipline, no tax increases, no new debt), 5B.4 (regulation, state sector preference), 5B.5 (anti-corruption "dando ejemplo"), 5B.6 (budget reorientation toward infrastructure/social), 5B.7 (transparency/anti-corruption promises), 5B.8 (targeting vulnerable populations, poverty reduction), 5B.9 (fuel price shock mitigation), 5B.10 (trajectory improvement framing).
**Adjacent context:** U0004 covers opposition period; U0006 continues campaign platform details.
**Cited lenses:** 5B.1, 5B.2, 5B.3, 5B.4, 5B.5, 5B.6, 5B.7, 5B.8, 5B.9, 5B.10

---

### U0006 — INCLUDE
**Relevance:** High. Campaign platform continuation: "socialdemocracia pragmática," free-market orthodoxy + rejection of privatization, state petroleum (Pemex) protection, pragmatic signaling to investors, anti-corruption promise ("hacer justicia sin venganza"), moral/religious conservatism framing. Policy continuity into December 2018 inauguration.
**5B lenses:** 5B.1 (mixed market + state model), 5B.2 (technocrat appointments), 5B.3 (macroeconomic discipline, Banco México autonomy), 5B.4 (state preference in energy), 5B.5 (anti-corruption promise but against allies), 5B.6 (infrastructure spending promises), 5B.7 (reliability of economic information pledge), 5B.10 (trajectory framing vs EPN).
**Adjacent context:** U0005 covers campaign program; U0007 begins security/migration/economic tensions.
**Cited lenses:** 5B.1, 5B.2, 5B.3, 5B.4, 5B.5, 5B.6, 5B.7, 5B.10

---

### U0007 — INCLUDE
**Relevance:** Low. Trade negotiation context (USMCA replacing NAFTA), migration economic pressures, border tensions with Trump. External economic shock context for 5B.9. USMCA characterized as beneficial to Mexico.
**5B lenses:** 5B.9 (external shock: Trump tariffs, migration crisis, trade renegotiation), 5B.10 (trajectory under external pressure).
**Adjacent context:** U0006 covers inauguration policy platform; U0008 begins biographical section 1.
**Cited lenses:** 5B.9, 5B.10

---

### U0008–U0031 — EXCLUDE
**Exclusion reason:** Pre-presidential biographical narrative (1970s–2005). Personal history, party formation, PRD founding, DF government, 2006 election campaign, desafuero, "presidencia legítima." Contains no substantive economic policy execution during the target presidency. Some policy positions mentioned (anti-FOBAPROA rhetoric, opposition to Salinas/Pedraza) are opposition-period framing, not governing record. The videoescándalo (U0022–U0023) touches 5B.5 but predates the presidency and is testimonial to others' corruption, not his policy execution.

---

### U0032–U0041 — EXCLUDE
**Exclusion reason:** 2006 post-electoral conflict narrative, "presidencia legítima" opposition period (2006–2012), 2012 campaign. These chunks document political contestation, mobilization strategy, and electoral fraud claims. Economic references are campaign rhetoric or opposition framing, not governing record. Key economic critiques (FOBAPROA, energy reform) are stated positions in opposition, not implemented policy.

---

### U0042–U0048 — EXCLUDE
**Exclusion reason:** Opposition period 2012–2016, MORENA founding, policy critique of Peña Nieto's energy/telecom/labor reforms. Economic content is opposition framing and campaign positioning. FOBAPROA critique (U0042) and energy sovereignty claims (U0047) are pre-presidency opposition stances. No governing record evidence present.

---

### U0049–U0051 — EXCLUDE
**Exclusion reason:** 2012 electoral defeat, TEPJF ruling, PRD-MORENA split narrative. Post-election legal/political aftermath. No economic governance evidence.

---

### U0052–U0059 — EXCLUDE
**Exclusion reason:** Opposition period 2012–2017, MORENA institutionalization, 2017 Estado de México election, anti-EPN messaging. Critique of EPN energy reform (U0054), 2016 election results, "descomposición social" framing. Pre-presidency opposition period.

---

### U0060–U0067 — INCLUDE
**Relevance:** High. 2018 campaign platform full articulation (U0062): austerity without tax increases, fuel self-sufficiency, anti-corruption, social programs (adult pensions, youth employment), energy policy reversal, USMCA/Trump context, trade/migration policy. U0063: security-justice nexus, "causas sociales" framing, Guardia Nacional, anti-corruption promise. U0064–U0065: election victory, "no mentir, no robar, no traicionar," corruption eradication promise, reconciliation framing, transition pledge. U0066: electoral tsunami, congressional majority, gubernatorial wins. These chunks contain the substantive policy platform for the 2018–2024 presidency and the stated governing philosophy with direct economic-policy content.

**5B lenses (U0060):** 5B.1 (coalition pragmatism), 5B.2 (technocrat signals), 5B.3 (free-market + discipline), 5B.4 (state preference), 5B.5 (anti-corruption promise), 5B.8 (religious/moral conservatism), 5B.10 (transformation narrative).

**5B lenses (U0062):** 5B.1 (austerity + investment reorientation), 5B.2 (institutional signals), 5B.3 (no new debt, fiscal discipline), 5B.4 (energy regulation), 5B.5 (anti-corruption), 5B.6 (budget priorities: social, infrastructure), 5B.7 (corruption eradication promise), 5B.8 (poverty-first targeting), 5B.9 (fuel price policy, Trump tariffs), 5B.10 (trajectory improvement claim).

**5B lenses (U0063):** 5B.5 (corruption eradication), 5B.7 (information/reliability), 5B.8 (social causes), 5B.9 (security as economic shock), 5B.10 (structural causes framing).

**5B lenses (U0064):** 5B.1 (transformation vs continuity), 5B.5 (anti-corruption pledge), 5B.7 (transparency promise), 5B.10 (trajectory commitment).

**5B lenses (U0065):** 5B.1 (sustainability of change), 5B.5 (impunity eradication), 5B.7 (three principles: no lying, no stealing, not betraying), 5B.10 (durability of transformation).

**5B lenses (U0066):** 5B.1 (policy mandate), 5B.3 (fiscal/majority context), 5B.10 (magnitude of electoral mandate for structural change).

**Adjacent context:** U0061 ends with campaign registration; U0062 begins campaign program detail; U0067 is publisher boilerplate — excluded.

**Cited lenses:** 5B.1, 5B.2, 5B.3, 5B.4, 5B.5, 5B.6, 5B.7, 5B.8, 5B.9, 5B.10 (U0062); 5B.5, 5B.7, 5B.8, 5B.9, 5B.10 (U0063); 5B.1, 5B.5, 5B.7, 5B.10 (U0064–U0065)

---

## Excluded Chunks

| Chunk ID | Primary Exclusion Reason |
|---|---|
| U0008–U0031 | Pre-presidential biographical/opposition narrative; no governing economic record for 2018–2024 presidency |
| U0032–U0041 | 2006–2012 opposition period; electoral contestation, "presidencia legítima" mobilization; economic content is campaign/opposition framing only |
| U0042–U0048 | 2012–2016 opposition; MORENA founding; policy critique of EPN reforms; pre-presidency |
| U0049–U0051 | 2012 electoral defeat aftermath; PRD-MORENA split; no economic governance evidence |
| U0052–U0059 | 2012–2017 opposition period; anti-EPN messaging; pre-presidency |
| U0067 | Publisher boilerplate (CIDOB institutional footer); no substantive content |

---

## Summary

| Decision | Count | Chunk IDs |
|---|---|---|
| **Included** | 7 | U0001, U0002, U0003, U0004, U0005, U0006, U0007, U0060–U0066 |
| **Excluded** | 60 | U0008–U0031, U0032–U0041, U0042–U0048, U0049–U0051, U0052–U0059, U0067 |

**Rationale:** The CIDOB biography is primarily a political career narrative. Substantive economic-policy content for Chapter 5B purposes appears in: (a) the 2018 campaign platform articulation (U0005–U0007, U0060–U0066), and (b) the biographical/professional background that contextualizes his governing philosophy (U0001–U0004). The bulk of the document (U0008–U0065 excluding the campaign platform sections) is pre-presidential biographical detail, opposition-period mobilization, electoral contestation, and institutional history — excluded because it does not evidence economic governance during the 2018–2024 presidency under evaluation.
